description: H1 location test (9b work-plan step 1): decomposes the witnessed Δ_λ ≈ q₀^(10A−5) exponent as ord(B_AME) − ord(B_pred) per isotope and measures which side carries the 10-per-nucleon increment. Framework trace side: +1.2…+2.9 q₀-units/nucleon (wrong magnitude and sign for H1); experimental B_AME side: +11.5…+12.8. Verdict: H1 forbidden at the proposed location — the exponent is not a crossing-count identity of the canonical trace difference. Diagnostic only; nothing wired.

data.verdict: H1 FORBIDDEN at the proposed location: the canonical trace difference contributes +1.2…+2.9 q₀-units/nucleon (and toward 0 with A), so no crossing/jet bookkeeping of W_free vs W_atom can yield the 10A−5 exponent; the increment is carried by B_AME's empirical growth. Deriving 10A−5 from word combinatorics is equivalent to deriving the binding curve itself. The 2026-06-09 observation stays near-match tier, now characterised as: B_AME ≈ E₀·q₀^(10A−5)·(trace factor drifting q₀^{+1..+3}/nucleon toward 1).
